purpose: Origin of the crates.io release counter. The commit that ADDED this file is commit zero; one 0.1.<patch> release is owed per 10 commits after it.
how_to_reset_the_counter: git rm release/release.json && commit; then re-add it in a following commit. The counter restarts from whichever commit re-adds the file.
why_state_lives_here_and_on_the_registry: Nothing about the release version is written back by the workflow (that would feed the commit counter that triggers it). The repo holds only the origin; crates.io holds how many releases exist.
